name: Build a Reading Habit from the Ground Up
equipment: A book you are currently reading
instructions: If earlier attempts have not stuck, restart with a genuinely smaller commitment than you think you need.
Choose a book you are excited about over one you feel you "should" read -- enjoyment is what carries a new habit through its first weeks.
Give yourself a specific, low-stakes time and place, not just an intention to "read more."
Watch today's video for a ground-up approach to habit building.
